The four legacy carryovers (786/527/627/603) now have 12 consecutive milestone appearances. Exp 641, which entered as a 'new entrant' in .70, has a second consecutive appearance — it is transitioning from a new entrant to a pattern. Combined cumulative waste across all five slowest experiments: ~2,644 min (44.1 hours) across their respective appearance runs.

gpu_state_at_close.temperature_status: GOOD — 0C differential (seventh consecutive clean close at 45C/45C), 0% utilization on both GPUs at milestone end

dualgpu_status.note: DualGPURunner validated (Exp 856, 1.979x throughput) but NOT wired into VerifyRepairPipeline for the SIXTH consecutive milestone post-deployment. GPU monitor at close explicitly suggests: 'Both GPUs are idle. Use DualGPURunner to run Qwen on GPU 0 and Gemma on GPU 1 simultaneously.' This recommendation has appeared every milestone since .65. Cumulative foregone savings since deployment: ~360 min. This remains the single highest-ROI unimplemented improvement.

experiment_count_analysis.note: Count rose from 800 (.70) to 809 (.71) — +9 experiments, reversing the prior three-milestone declining trend (805 → 802 → 800 → 809). 109 experiments over the 700 cap; each over-cap experiment adds ~5 min to milestone wall time (~45 min of pure volume overhead). The improvement streak in .67-.70 was entirely count-driven; this count uptick directly explains the +57 min regression.

bottlenecks_identified: IMPROVEMENT_STREAK_BROKEN_BY_COUNT_UPTICK: Wall time increased +57 min (+1.48%) because experiment count rose from 800 to 809. All four prior improvements (.67-.70) were count-driven, not governance-driven. Without manifest enforcement, any count fluctuation immediately reverses the trend.

GOVERNANCE_FAILURE_FOUR_LEGACY_CARRYOVERS_12_MILESTONES: Exp 786 (77 min), Exp 527 (52 min), Exp 627 (51 min), Exp 603 (44 min) have run in every milestone since .59 despite 8–12 consecutive retirement recommendations; cumulative waste across these four ~2,420 min (40.3 hours). The only fix is adding them to exclusion_manifest.yaml — no engineering required.

EXP641_SECOND_SLOW_APPEARANCE_ROOT_CAUSE_UNKNOWN: Exp 641 (HermesVerifierAdapter v2, 42 min) has now appeared in slowest-5 for two consecutive milestones without a documented root cause. If undiagnosed, it will compound into a third carryover slot.

DUALGPU_NOT_WIRED_SIXTH_CONSECUTIVE: Both RTX 3090s at 0% utilization / 45C / 4MB while GPU experiments ran sequentially. DualGPURunner achieves 1.979x throughput but has been idle for 6 milestones post-deployment; ~360 min cumulative foregone savings.

NO_TIMEOUT_GOVERNOR: Exp 603 (44 min), Exp 641 (42 min), and other live-inference experiments have no hard wall-time cap. Uncapped experiments can run 2–4x their intended budget without triggering a conductor intervention.

SEQUENTIAL_PARAGRAPH_PROCESSING_SYMCODEVERIFIER: Exp 627 SymCodeVerifier processes paragraphs serially at 51 min. RETRO-SYMCODE-SERIAL was closed in .64 (implementation complete) but the dispatch-site wiring was never applied. This is a one-line fix that would cut Exp 627 to ~15 min.

EXPERIMENT_COUNT_RISING_AGAIN_109_OVER_CAP: Count rose from 800 to 809 — breaking the three-milestone decline. 109 experiments over the 700 cap produces ~45 min/milestone of pure volume overhead. Without a hard cap enforced at conductor pre-launch, count will continue to drift upward.
MODEL_PREDOWNLOAD_ABSENT: SOTA GGUF models not pre-cached before milestone start; first GPU experiment to need a 35B model pays 15–30 min download overhead inside its timed window.
DOC_RECONCILIATION_SERIAL: In-process changelog and JSON artifact writes run synchronously after each experiment. Across 809 experiments, serial I/O adds ~16–20 min to the milestone critical path.
improvements_suggested: IMMEDIATE — RETIRE EXP 786/527/627/603 TO EXCLUSION MANIFEST: Add all four to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml right now. Zero engineering required. These four experiments alone waste ~224 min/milestone. No planning session should propose them without explicit human override + documented root-cause fix. This is the single action with the best effort-to-savings ratio in the entire project.

IMMEDIATE — DIAGNOSE AND CONTAIN EXP 641: Read results/experiment_641_hermes_verifier_adapter_v2.json before milestone .72 begins. Two consecutive slow appearances without a diagnosis is the early-warning pattern for a fifth legacy carryover. Apply a timeout cap or batching fix, or retire now before it compounds.

HIGH — WIRE DUALGPURUNNER INTO VERIFYPREPAIRPIPELINE: One engineering session (~4 hours). Enables Qwen on GPU 0 + Gemma on GPU 1 simultaneously. GPU monitor already generates this suggestion every milestone close. Expected throughput gain 1.97x for GPU-bound experiments; ~60 min/milestone recovered indefinitely. Six milestones of idle post-deployment is a significant sunk-opportunity cost.

HIGH — APPLY HARD TIMEOUT GOVERNOR VIA CARNOT_EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: Add a per-experiment wall-time cap to ExperimentTemplate (default 30 min). Any experiment exceeding the cap writes status=timeout and honest_verdict=wall_time_cap_exceeded; conductor moves on. Prevents uncapped live-inference experiments from silently consuming 2–4x their budget.

HIGH — ENFORCE EXPERIMENT COUNT CAP AT 700: Count rose to 809 — the three-milestone decline reversed. The conductor must enforce a hard ceiling at 700; each new experiment proposed requires retiring an existing one. This directly controls the primary driver of wall-time regressions.

MEDIUM — WIRE SYMCODEVERIFIER PARAGRAPH BATCHING AT DISPATCH SITE: RETRO-SYMCODE-SERIAL implementation is confirmed complete. The dispatch-site wiring is a one-line fix that cuts Exp 627 from 51 min to ~15 min. This is the eighth consecutive milestone this fix has been recommended without application.

MEDIUM — PRE-DOWNLOAD SOTA GGUFS AS MILESTONE PRE-FLIGHT: Add a zero-th experiment that downloads and validates Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF, Gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF, and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-GGUF before any timed inference. Saves 15–30 min of download overhead from inside timed experiment windows.

LOW — BACKGROUND DOC RECONCILIATION: Move changelog and JSON artifact writes to an async background writer with a flush at experiment end. Saves ~16–20 min of synchronous I/O per milestone with no correctness impact.

LOW — TRACK WHETHER IMPROVEMENT IS STRUCTURAL: The improvement trend has been: -91, -61, -10, -100, +57. The volatility confirms the streak was not structural. Introduce a governance metric: 'pct of milestone savings attributable to manifest enforcement vs count fluctuation.' Without this signal, the conductor cannot distinguish real progress from noise.

improvement_analysis.note: The four-consecutive-improvement streak (.67 through .70) was never structural. Each improvement was driven by slower experiment count growth, not by applying governance fixes. .71 count rose +9 (800 → 809), and wall time rose +57 min, confirming the causal relationship. The improvement streak will not resume until manifest enforcement reduces the active experiment pool below 700.

questions_answered.which_experiments_took_longest_and_why: Exp 786 (77 min): Gemma4 OOM — GPU exhausts VRAM during model loading; retries until wall-time exceeded. Now at 12 consecutive milestone appearances with no root-cause fix applied. Exp 527 (52 min): Post-retirement live-100q precision running uncapped live inference without an experiment-level timeout; recommended for retirement for 12 consecutive milestones. Exp 627 (51 min): SymCodeVerifier processes paragraphs serially; paragraph batching fix is implemented and confirmed correct but not wired at the dispatch site across 8 consecutive retro cycles. Exp 603 (44 min): CoACEExtractor live GenP training loop runs uncapped; exceeds 30-min target by ~14 min every milestone. Exp 641 (42 min): HermesVerifierAdapter v2 step-by-step generation; root cause unknown after two consecutive slow appearances.
questions_answered.was_gpu_utilization_efficient: No. Both RTX 3090s closed at 0% utilization / 45C / 4MB — identical to .70. DualGPURunner (1.979x throughput, Exp 856) is deployed but not wired into the pipeline for the sixth consecutive milestone. The GPU monitor at close explicitly flagged: 'Both GPUs are idle. Use DualGPURunner to run Qwen on GPU 0 and Gemma on GPU 1 simultaneously.' Cumulative foregone savings since deployment: ~360 min.
questions_answered.were_there_zombie_processes_wasting_reso: No zombie processes at close. GPU Zombie Killer (Exp 780, REQ-INFRA-055) is active and working correctly. Clean close at 4MB/0%/45C on both GPUs for the seventh consecutive milestone. Zombie issue is fully resolved and is no longer a bottleneck.
questions_answered.could_any_experiments_have_been_parallel: Yes. All GPU-bound experiments loading Qwen3.6-35B or Gemma4-31B are parallelizable via DualGPURunner (one model per GPU). Estimated parallelizable fraction: ~30% of milestone wall time. Additionally, SymCodeVerifier paragraph processing within Exp 627 is inherently parallelizable — dispatch-site batching wiring is the only missing piece. Doc reconciliation I/O can also be backgrounded without correctness impact.
questions_answered.was_the_preflight_test_suite_a_bottlenec: Not identified as a bottleneck this milestone. Pre-flight (GPU Zombie Killer) runs quickly and is structurally necessary. The bottleneck is the unguarded historical experiment queue allowing retired and carryover experiments to re-run without manifest enforcement.
questions_answered.were_doc_reconciliation_passes_efficient: Partially. In-process reconciliation (scripts/in_process_doc_reconcile.py) runs synchronously, adding ~16–20 min of I/O latency per milestone across 809 experiments. Background async writes would eliminate this from the critical path with no correctness risk. Impact is secondary compared to manifest governance and DualGPU wiring.
questions_answered.what_tooling_changes_would_speed_up_next: Ranked by effort-to-savings ratio: (1) Add Exp 786/527/627/603 to exclusion_manifest.yaml NOW — zero engineering, saves ~224 min immediately. (2) Wire DualGPURunner into VerifyRepairPipeline — ~4 hours engineering, saves ~60 min/milestone indefinitely, already validated at 1.979x. (3) Add CARNOT_EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES governor to ExperimentTemplate — saves variable time by hard-capping long-tail experiments. (4) Enforce 700-experiment count cap at conductor pre-launch — prevents volume accumulation that drives wall-time regressions.
